verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Settlement Report that gives a complete breakdown of each payout, covering all transactions, fees and deductions in a single settlement. The Balances API and Settlements API add historical balance data for reconciliation. Nothing in the evidence shows a finance-ops user can control or configure the payout schedule, so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented control over payout frequency/schedule, explicit itemization of refunds and chargebacks per payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
